"""Dry-run test for GPT-2-medium pipeline on CPU.

Loads GPT-2-medium, runs 1 mini-batch of training, extracts embeddings,
computes spectral metrics. Reports success/failure and memory estimates.
"""
import sys
import os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

import time
import torch
import numpy as np
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

MODEL_NAME = "gpt2-medium"
CACHE_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"
DEVICE = "cpu"

def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("DRY RUN: GPT-2-medium pipeline test (CPU)")
    print("=" * 60)

    # 1. Load model and tokenizer
    print("\n[1/5] Loading model and tokenizer...")
    t0 = time.time()
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, cache_dir=CACHE_DIR)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, cache_dir=CACHE_DIR)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
    model.to(DEVICE)
    print(f"  Loaded in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
    print(f"  Parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")
    print(f"  Vocab size: {tokenizer.vocab_size}")
    print(f"  Hidden size: {model.config.n_embd}")
    print(f"  Num layers: {model.config.n_layer}")
    print(f"  pad_token: '{tokenizer.pad_token}' (id={tokenizer.pad_token_id})")
    print(f"  bos_token: '{tokenizer.bos_token}' (id={tokenizer.bos_token_id})")
    print(f"  eos_token: '{tokenizer.eos_token}' (id={tokenizer.eos_token_id})")

    # GPU memory estimate
    param_bytes = sum(p.numel() * p.element_size() for p in model.parameters())
    grad_bytes = param_bytes  # gradients
    optimizer_bytes = param_bytes * 2  # AdamW: momentum + variance
    activations_est = param_bytes * 0.5  # rough
    total_est_gb = (param_bytes + grad_bytes + optimizer_bytes + activations_est) / (1024**3)
    print(f"\n  GPU memory estimate (training): ~{total_est_gb:.1f} GB")
    print(f"    Model params: {param_bytes/1024**3:.2f} GB")
    print(f"    Gradients: {grad_bytes/1024**3:.2f} GB")
    print(f"    Optimizer states: {optimizer_bytes/1024**3:.2f} GB")
    print(f"    Activations (est): {activations_est/1024**3:.2f} GB")

    # 2. Create fake batch
    print("\n[2/5] Creating test batch (batch_size=4, seq_len=512)...")
    batch_size = 4
    seq_len = 512
    input_ids = torch.randint(0, tokenizer.vocab_size, (batch_size, seq_len))
    attention_mask = torch.ones_like(input_ids)

    # 3. Forward pass + loss
    print("\n[3/5] Forward pass (training mode)...")
    t0 = time.time()
    model.train()
    labels = input_ids.clone()
    outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels)
    loss = outputs.loss
    loss.backward()
    print(f"  Forward+backward in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
    print(f"  Loss: {loss.item():.4f}")

    # 4. Extract embeddings (hidden states)
    print("\n[4/5] Extracting embeddings (last hidden state, mean-pooled)...")
    model.eval()
    t0 = time.time()
    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, output_hidden_states=True)
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-1]  # (batch, seq, hidden)
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        sum_hidden = (hidden_states * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1)
        count = mask_expanded.sum(dim=1)
        mean_pooled = sum_hidden / count  # (batch, hidden)
    print(f"  Embedding shape: {mean_pooled.shape}")
    print(f"  Extraction in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    # 5. Compute spectral metrics
    print("\n[5/5] Computing spectral metrics (SVD on 4 samples)...")
    representations = mean_pooled.numpy()
    U, sv, Vt = np.linalg.svd(representations, full_matrices=False)
    sv_nonzero = sv[sv > 1e-10]
    p = sv_nonzero / sv_nonzero.sum()
    entropy = -np.sum(p * np.log(p))
    eff_rank = np.exp(entropy)
    log_det = float(np.sum(np.log(sv_nonzero)))
    sigma1 = float(sv[0])

    print(f"  Singular values: {sv}")
    print(f"  Effective rank: {eff_rank:.4f}")
    print(f"  Log-det: {log_det:.4f}")
    print(f"  sigma_1: {sigma1:.4f}")

    # 6. Test generation
    print("\n[6/6] Test text generation (5 tokens)...")
    t0 = time.time()
    bos_id = tokenizer.bos_token_id if tokenizer.bos_token_id is not None else tokenizer.eos_token_id
    gen_input = torch.full((1, 1), bos_id, dtype=torch.long)
    with torch.no_grad():
        generated = model.generate(
            gen_input, max_new_tokens=5, temperature=1.0, top_k=50,
            do_sample=True, pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id
        )
    text = tokenizer.decode(generated[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
    print(f"  Generated: '{text}'")
    print(f"  Generation in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("DRY RUN: ALL TESTS PASSED")
    print("=" * 60)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
